chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Asbāṭ narrated from Muḥammad ibn Ḥumrān, from Zurārah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who gives a shared charity, he said: “It is permissible.”

key_terms.الرَّجُلِ: a man; the legal subject mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.بِالصَّدَقَةِ: by means of charity; a charitable donation

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to give shared charity according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام concerning shared charity. It states that giving charity in a jointly held or shared form is permissible in Islamic law.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5584 - Ali ibn Asbat narrated from Muhammad ibn Humran from Zurara, who reported from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), regarding a man who gives a shared charity (sadaqah mushtarakah).
